title: Weather and Seasons
seo_title: Kindergarten Science: Weather and Seasons Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Daily and seasonal changes affect all living things: weather (temperature, cloud cover, precipitation, wind), the four seasons, and how plants and animals change to survive (migration, hibernation). (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science K, Earth and Space Science)
meta_desc: Free Kindergarten science worksheets (BC): sunny, rainy and snowy weather, the four seasons, dressing for the weather, and how animals get ready for winter. 100 picture questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

Weather is what the sky and air are like today.

  • It can be sunny, cloudy, rainy, snowy or windy.
  • The four seasons are spring, summer, fall and winter.
  • Some animals sleep or fly away in winter.
Example

It is snowing. What should you wear?

Snow means it is cold.

Answer: a warm coat and boots

Example

Which season comes after winter?

Think of the order.

Answer: spring

Common mistakes

  • Thinking it is summer all year everywhere.
  • Saying all animals hibernate.

faq.a: Food is hard to find in winter, so they migrate to warmer places.

springsmall new leaves and blossom

fallred, orange and brown leaves falling off

Ethan looked at the same oak tree in every season. In which season did the leaves change colour?
items.e: Leaves change colour and fall in fall.

items.q: Which of these trees is deciduous: a Christmas tree (spruce), a fir tree, a monkey puzzle tree or a silver birch?
items.e: Deciduous trees lose their leaves in fall; evergreens keep them.

items.q: Is a holly tree deciduous or evergreen?
